answer: Each identity stakes 80 credits for one thaw forecast for a grove, signing its predicted thaw day and paying a fee. The forecast names one terrace plot, whose thaw an auditor checks against a tundra station record: within three days keeps the bond, farther burns 40, copies share one score. Under one funding key, identity k pays a rising 20+8(k-1): the 1000th pays 8012, and 1000 fakes pay 4016000 plus 80000 locked. A rented-forecast ring fails: replayed signatures mismatch the filing key, and copies gain no weight. An honest agent files one forecast, pays 20 once, and recovers its bond.
